00
User Authentication & Access Control

Access to ChronicleV7 is strictly protected by role-based route guards and single sign-on (SSO) or local credentials.

1
Navigate to Login Gateway
Open https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/login. Enter your corporate email and secure password.
2
Role-Based Dashboard Dispatch
Upon successful authentication, the route guard dispatches Admin users to /admin/dashboard, Recruiters to /recruiter/dashboard, and Ops Validators to account specific views.
Role Identifier Default Landing Page Operational Permissions & Scope
Administrator /admin/dashboard Full read/write access to system settings, user management, backups, and security audit logs.
Recruiter /recruiter/dashboard Manage candidate applications, conduct initial interviews, assign tokens, schedule Ops Val slots.
Ops Validator /recruiter/interview-rooms Assigned to specific client target accounts; conducts final validator interviews and logs pass/fail decisions.
01
Quick Access — Quick Settings

Route / Trigger: /admin/settings/quick or Quick Settings Sidebar Button.

1
Theme Personalization
Toggle UI color palettes between Microsoft Blue, Indigo, Emerald, Purple, and High-Contrast Dark modes.
2
Audio Chime & Queue Sound Controls
Adjust token call audio chime volume and voice synthesizer pitch for Queue Display announcements.
3
Auto-Refresh Interval Polling
Set background synchronization rate for live candidate queue cards (30s, 60s, 5m).
02
Main Module

2.1 Dashboard (/recruiter/dashboard & /admin/dashboard)

Real-time operational dashboard providing high-level recruitment metrics, active queue counts, and recent activity streams.

https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/recruiter/dashboard
Figure 2.1: Executive Account Analytics Dashboard showing real-time applicant quotas and pass rates.

2.2 Forums (/forums)

Internal communication portal for recruiters and Operations Validators to exchange candidate feedback notes, account updates, and hiring policy announcements.

2.3 Calendar (/calendar)

Interactive schedule view for candidate interview bookings, validator availability slots, and room occupancy schedules.

2.4 My Tasks (/my-tasks)

Personal task list for recruiters detailing assigned applicants awaiting evaluation, pending call-backs, and deadline alerts.

2.5 Profile (/profile)

User profile management page to update full name, email, avatar image, security password, and view assigned target accounts.

03
Recruitment — Applicant Tracker

3.1 Application Management (/recruiter/applicant-management)

Central intake workspace featuring high-density candidate tables, multi-column search, and granular filters.

https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/recruiter/applicant-management
Figure 3.1: High-Density Candidate Intake Masterlist with Target Account & Ops Validator Filters.
FEATURE ZOOM Granular Filtering Toolbar
1. Target Account Filter: Narrows down candidate view by specific client account (e.g., DoorDash, Enercare, Keller Postman).
2. Ops Validator Filter: Filters applicants assigned to specific Operations Validators.
3. Stage Status Pills: Quickly toggle between Applied, Typing Test, Initial Interview, Assessment, Final Interview, Hired, Failed.

3.2 Interview Form (/recruiter/tracker/interview-form)

Full-screen candidate evaluation interface used during live interviews to record scoring metrics, question notes, and final recommendations.

https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/recruiter/tracker/interview-form
Figure 3.2: Standalone Candidate Interview Scoring & Competency Form.

3.3 Masterlist (/recruiter/tracker/masterlist)

Global repository of all historic candidate records supporting bulk Excel export, candidate archive tools, and batch status transitions.

3.4 For Ops Val Scheduling (/recruiter/scheduling)

Dedicated booking engine allowing recruiters to select qualified candidates and schedule final validation interviews with designated Operations Validators based on account assignment.

https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/recruiter/scheduling
Figure 3.4: Ops Validator Slot Scheduling Calendar & Candidate Queue.
04
Recruitment — Interview Management

4.1 Interview Rooms (/recruiter/interview-rooms)

Real-time room management board displaying Onsite and Online interview room availability (AVAILABLE vs OCCUPIED), candidate queues, and interviewer assignments.

https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/recruiter/interview-rooms
Figure 4.1: Real-Time Interview Rooms Status Board & Room Assignment Grid.
KEY FEATURE Dual-Role Interviewer Selector Architecture

When adding or editing an interview room in AddRoomModal or EditRoomModal, recruiters can dynamically set the assigned evaluator using strict role separation:

1
Select Mode Pill: [ Recruiter ] vs [ Ops Validator ]
Clicking [ Recruiter ] filters out all Operations Validators, presenting only recruiters in the dropdown.
2
Ops Validator Target Account Selection
Clicking [ Ops Validator ] displays a Target Account prompt first. Selecting an account (e.g. DoorDash) dynamically populates the interviewer dropdown with only the Ops Validators assigned to that account.
Modal Overlay — Edit Interview Room
Figure 4.2: Edit Room Modal with Target Account & Dual-Role Interviewer Selector.
Modal Dropdown — Recruiter Filter
Figure 4.3: Filtered Recruiter Selector Dropdown (Ops Validators Strictly Excluded).

4.2 Queue Console (/recruiter/queue-control)

Live token calling console for dispatching candidates to interview rooms and broadcasting token calls to the public Queue Display screen (/queue-display).

05
Recruitment — Hiring & Accounts

5.1 Job Postings (/job-postings)

Public job portal displaying open positions, department badges, hiring requirements, and direct candidate registration links.

5.2 Accounts & Support (/admin/accounts)

Administrative account registry for managing client accounts, hiring quotas, support roles, and sub-account allocations.

https://chroniclev7.contactpoint360.com/admin/hiring/accounts
Figure 5.2: Account Registry Dashboard with Web App / Excel Views & Quota Management.
06
Insights & Reports

6.1 Report Dashboard (/recruiter/reports)

Executive reporting suite featuring account target analysis, candidate pass/fail rates, time-to-hire metrics, and recruiter conversion ratios.

6.2 Tests Tracker (/recruiter/tracker/tests)

Applicant assessment tracking portal recording typing test scores (Words Per Minute WPM, Accuracy %, duration, error logs).

6.3 Employee Tracker (/admin/employee-tracker)

Internal employee registry mapping staff IDs, assigned account teams, and operational statuses.

6.4 Security Logs (/admin/audit-logs)

Security audit log tracking user authentication attempts, candidate status modifications, room edits, and permission updates with IP address and timestamps.

07
System & References — MHRT Module

The MHRT (Headcount-to-Revenue Requisition) module (/recruiter/mhrt) spans 6 operational sub-tabs:

MHRT Sub-Tab Operational Scope & Workflow
H2R Creation Submit new headcount requisition requests mapped to client target accounts.
H2R Division Allocate approved headcount slots across operational department divisions.
Accounts Manage account code budget assignments and client billing references.
Salary Configure pay bands, compensation rates, and target budget caps.
Assigned Time Off Log operational holiday schedules, planned downtime, and leave allocations.
Directory Access contact information for MHRT account leads and department managers.
08
System & References — CRM Settings

Administrative system configuration suite (/admin/settings) comprising 7 setup sub-tabs:

Setting Sub-Tab Scope & Setup Functionality
Question Bank Manage interview scoring questions, competency weightings, and rubrics.
Typing Test Configure typing test text prompts, 60s countdown timer, and passing WPM thresholds.
Email Templates Edit automated candidate notification emails, interview invitations, and Job Offer letters.
AI Settings Configure AI interview evaluation prompts, automated scoring weights, and feedback criteria.
Active Tasks Monitor background database synchronization jobs, socket workers, and async tasks.
Backups Create full database backups, restore system checkpoints, and clear temporary caches.
User Management Create staff user accounts, assign roles (recruiter_a, ops_validator, admin), and scope target account access.
